official_inputs.note: Financing-plan amounts; definition is not identical to an annual effective-interest-rate repricing share.
Maastricht/EU-methodology debt stock; may not match every financing-plan instrument boundary.
Strategy targets are risk-management bounds/targets, not realised empirical shares.

why_not_parameter_m: Redemption is not identical to the share whose effective interest rate is repriced during the period.
Floating-rate refixing may occur without principal redemption.
Prefunding, cash buffers, instrument/currency mix and debt-definition boundaries can separate financing-plan redemptions from the stock used in interest-cost accounting.
The 10-20 percent refixing number in the strategy is a target/risk bound rather than an observed realised 2025 value.

required_missing_observables: definitionally matched realised share of debt repriced/refinanced by period
effective interest rate on the matched opening debt stock
marginal issuance/refinancing yield matched by currency and maturity
interest expenditure reconciled to the same debt/instrument boundary

final_disposition.reason: Official sources establish refinancing materiality and useful bounds/proxies, but do not identify the model's repricing share m on a definitionally matched time series. A point estimate would require an unjustified mapping across debt concepts.
final_disposition.future_retest_requirement: Assemble maturity/refixing schedules and matched effective/marginal rates on a consistent government-debt boundary; then validate historical interest-cost reproduction before activation.
